tasks.title: Scaffold the Vite React TypeScript workspace
tasks.description: Create the runnable workspace: Vite 8 with the React plugin, React 19, strict TypeScript 7, Vitest with jsdom, a Playwright config stub, a base-path-aware build, a Vite plugin that injects a same-origin CSP meta tag into the built HTML only, and npm scripts for dev, build, typecheck, unit tests, E2E, static serving and budget checks. Dev mode must stay CSP-free so React Fast Refresh keeps working. Mount a placeholder App through src/main.tsx. Do not implement game screens or engine rules.

requirements: The workspace produces a static dist build that honors a non-root base path
The built HTML carries a same-origin CSP meta tag while the dev server HTML does not
The composition root renders the app shell and its scripts are documented

ENG-FR-10: Scaffold a Vite 8 and React 19 TypeScript workspace with strict typechecking, Vitest with jsdom, a Playwright configuration, a base-path-aware static build, a same-origin CSP meta tag injected into the production HTML only, and documented npm scripts, using src/main.tsx and src/App.tsx as the composition root.

SHL-FR-01: Route every screen through App.tsx using one discriminated Screen union: menu, how-to-play, settings, solo setup, run overview, battle, reward, run result, duel setup, privacy, round result and match result.
VIS-SEC-01: Ship a same-origin Content-Security-Policy meta tag in the production build only, and forbid dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval and new Function anywhere in application code.
acceptanceCriteria: npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build all succeed from the repository root
The Vitest environment is jsdom and the App test renders the composition root
Vite reads VITE_BASE and the built index references assets under that base
dist/index.html contains the same-origin Content-Security-Policy meta tag and the HTML served by npm run dev does not, so Fast Refresh is unaffected
package.json exposes dev, build, preview, typecheck, test, test:e2e, serve:dist, check:build and check:budget scripts
constraints: Use the verified versions from PRD section 6.1
Inject the CSP through a build-only Vite plugin or a post-build step; do not hard-code it into the shared index.html template
Do not add a state-management, routing or CSS framework dependency
Do not implement gameplay or screens beyond the shell placeholder

VIS-CON-01: Use React 19.3.1, Vite 8.3.5, TypeScript 7.0.2, Vitest 5.0.5, Testing Library 16.3.3 and Playwright 1.64.1; add no runtime state, routing or CSS framework, and do not introduce an unverified package.

VIS-CON-02: Produce a static dist build that works from a GitHub Pages project subpath and from the local preview server; resolve every asset through the Vite base URL and write no host-specific runtime behavior.

tasks.title: Define engine types and the seeded PRNG
tasks.description: Create the framework-free engine type model and a serializable 32-bit PRNG with seeded shuffle. Export Element, CardType, StatusKind, CardDefinition, EnemyDefinition, BattleState, BattleSnapshot, EnemyPlan and result types. Include the PRNG state in every random API call. Do not implement damage, turn flow or UI.

requirements: The PRNG exposes nextUint32, shuffle and serialize/restore with identical sequences after restore

ENG-FR-05: Drive shuffles, reward offers and AI tie-breaks from an explicit 32-bit seed and serializable PRNG state, so identical seeds and action sequences reproduce identical battles, and never call Math.random inside the engine.
acceptanceCriteria: The same seed produces the same 100-value sequence and the same shuffle on repeat runs
Restoring serialized PRNG state continues the exact sequence
A shuffle is a permutation with no duplicated or dropped entries
A repository grep finds no Math.random call under src/engine
constraints: No runtime dependency may be added for randomness
All engine files must compile under strict TypeScript with no any

VIS-CON-01: Use React 19.3.1, Vite 8.3.5, TypeScript 7.0.2, Vitest 5.0.5, Testing Library 16.3.3 and Playwright 1.64.1; add no runtime state, routing or CSS framework, and do not introduce an unverified package.
VIS-CON-08: Keep gameplay rules in the pure engine and content values in data files; UI, controllers and content must not duplicate damage, draw, status or affordability logic.

tasks.title: Resolve field matchup, damage, defense and piercing
tasks.description: Implement the pure damage and field resolution functions from the pipeline and matchup table. Cover matching attacks (+2 and pierce), countered attacks (ceiling half, minimum 1 before defense, piercing overridden), Neutral fields, defense capped at 8, matching Ward bonus and persistent defense passed as an input. Exclude turn flow, drawing and enemy AI.

requirements: The full 5-by-5 field and attack-element matrix is implemented in one testable function
Defense gain clamps at 8 and piercing skips defense

ENG-FR-02: Resolve each attack as base damage, then Focus and Weaken modifiers, then field modifiers, then persistent defense. A matching attack gains +2 and pierces; a countered attack deals ceiling half with a minimum of 1 before defense and cannot pierce; a matching Ward gains +2 defense; defense is capped at 8.
acceptanceCriteria: Table-driven tests cover every field and attack element combination, including Neutral
Odd countered damage rounds up and never drops below 1 before defense
A countered piercing attack does not bypass defense
Defense clamps at 8 and a 9-point reduction request yields 8
A matching Ward adds 2 defense and the total still clamps at 8
constraints: Do not read React, DOM or storage from the engine
Do not hard-code card ids in damage logic
VIS-CON-08: Keep gameplay rules in the pure engine and content values in data files; UI, controllers and content must not duplicate damage, draw, status or affordability logic.

tasks.title: Apply Focus, Weaken and Regen stacks
tasks.description: Implement status application, per-attack consumption, turn-start Regen ticks and battle-end clearing with the caps in the status table. Expose helpers that the battle reducer and intent preview can call. Do not implement visual status display or card definitions.

requirements: Focus and Weaken each consume one stack per attack while both can apply simultaneously
Regen heals 2 and consumes one stack at the owner's turn start

ENG-FR-03: Implement Focus, Weaken and Regen as capped stacks: each attack consumes one Focus and one Weaken stack for +2 or -2 damage, Regen heals 2 at the owner's turn start and consumes one stack, caps are 3/3/2, and all statuses clear when the battle ends.
acceptanceCriteria: Applying more than the cap keeps Focus and Weaken at 3 and Regen at 2
An attack consumes one stack of each present status and returns the correct net modifier
Both statuses present nets to zero damage change and consumes one of each
Regen heals without exceeding maximum health and stops at zero stacks
Clearing statuses leaves all counters at zero
constraints: Status effects must not mutate the input state object
No UI or persistence concerns in this module
VIS-CON-08: Keep gameplay rules in the pure engine and content values in data files; UI, controllers and content must not duplicate damage, draw, status or affordability logic.

tasks.title: Implement the legal battle state machine
tasks.description: Build battle setup and the symmetric two-side turn loop: seeded deck shuffle, opening hand of 5, energy reset to 3, draw to 5 with overdraw burn, discard at end of turn, discard reshuffle, card play validation, energy gain beyond 3, field shifts, ward application, victory and defeat. Every action takes an explicit side so solo and duel share the engine. Reject actions after battle end and out of turn. Do not implement AI planning or snapshot serialization.

requirements: A turn starts with 3 energy and a hand of 5, and ends by discarding the hand
Card plays are atomic and validate cost, turn and battle phase

ENG-FR-01: Start each turn with exactly 3 energy, resetting rather than accumulating unspent energy; draw to a hand of 5, discard the entire hand at end of turn, reshuffle the discard pile when the draw pile empties, and burn cards drawn beyond 5. Card-granted energy may exceed 3 for the current turn.

ENG-FR-04: Begin each battle on a Neutral field with 0 defense, 40 player health and the enemy's configured health; apply each card atomically, reject unaffordable or out-of-turn actions, and end the battle immediately when either side reaches 0 health.

ENG-FR-11: Model both battle sides symmetrically with independent health, defense, deck, hand, discard, energy, statuses and turn ownership; expose play-card and end-turn actions for either side, and keep AI planning in a separate module used only by the solo mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup produces a 5-card hand and 3 energy on a Neutral field with 0 defense for both sides
Unspent energy does not carry into the next turn and card-granted energy can exceed 3 in the current turn
Drawing past 5 burns the extra card and drawing from an empty pile reshuffles the discard
An unaffordable card, an out-of-turn action and an action after victory are rejected without changing state
Reaching 0 health on either side ends the battle and further actions are rejected
Each side has independent health, defense, deck, hand, discard, energy and statuses, and play-card accepts the acting side
constraints: All exported mutators return a new state rather than mutating the argument
Card behavior comes from definitions, never from card-id conditionals
VIS-CON-08: Keep gameplay rules in the pure engine and content values in data files; UI, controllers and content must not duplicate damage, draw, status or affordability logic.

tasks.title: Serialize and restore battle snapshots
tasks.description: Implement a versioned BattleSnapshot serializer and validator for save/resume and duel round resets. Include every mutable battle field and the PRNG state, validate card ids against the supplied catalog, reject duplicate instance ids and impossible counts, and return typed errors. Do not read or write localStorage.

requirements: Snapshot round-trip preserves the exact next legal action set
Unknown schema versions and invalid card ids fail with typed errors

ENG-FR-08: Serialize and restore a complete battle snapshot covering decks, hands, discard, energy, health, defense, field, statuses, turn, phase, seed and PRNG state, such that a round-trip resumes to an identical next state.
acceptanceCriteria: Serializing and restoring a mid-battle state then playing the same card produces identical states
PRNG state survives the round-trip and continues the same shuffle sequence
Unknown schemaVersion, unknown card id, duplicate instance id and hand count above 5 are rejected
The serialized object contains no functions and survives JSON stringify and parse
constraints: Validation must happen before any state is returned
The module must not access browser storage
VIS-CON-08: Keep gameplay rules in the pure engine and content values in data files; UI, controllers and content must not duplicate damage, draw, status or affordability logic.

tasks.title: Plan enemy turns and compute the intent preview
tasks.description: Implement the deterministic enemy planner and intent preview. Apply the priority order, affordability simulation, boss counter-element bias and card-ID tie-break. Let the enemy draw and plan at the end of its turn so the player sees an exact next-turn plan. Recompute preview numbers from live field and defense without changing the plan. Do not render the plan or implement UI.

requirements: The planner follows the lethal, Ward, Shift, attack, utility priority and is deterministic
The preview lists each planned card with recomputed totals

ENG-FR-06: Plan enemy turns deterministically: prefer a lethal sequence, then a Ward at 12 or less enemy health, then a field-enabling Shift, then field-matching and highest damage-per-energy attacks; break ties by card ID, never plan an unaffordable card, and let the boss prefer the element that counters the player's starter element.

ENG-FR-07: Expose the enemy's full next-turn plan as an ordered card list with recomputed damage, defense, status and field effects; when the field or defense changes during the player turn, recompute the preview without changing the chosen cards.
acceptanceCriteria: A lethal plan is chosen whenever an affordable sequence kills the player
At 12 or less health a Ward is preferred before non-lethal attacks
A Shift that enables the enemy element is preferred over an unmatched attack
Equal candidates resolve by card ID and repeated planning returns the same plan
Changing the field or player defense changes preview totals but not the planned card ids
The boss prefers the Shift for the element that counters the player's starter element
The enemy plans after drawing at the end of its turn and never plans an unaffordable card
constraints: AI uses the same damage and status functions as the player
No randomness inside the planner beyond the seeded tie-break order
VIS-CON-08: Keep gameplay rules in the pure engine and content values in data files; UI, controllers and content must not duplicate damage, draw, status or affordability logic.

tasks.title: Verify seeded self-play legality and termination
tasks.description: Add a cross-module self-play test that runs seeded AI-versus-AI battles with representative decks, asserting termination, resource bounds, action legality and replay determinism. Keep it as an integration test over the public engine API. Do not add UI, persistence or content-specific tuning.

requirements: Every simulated battle terminates within 100 turns
Seeded replay of the same action log produces an identical final state

ENG-FR-09: Guarantee legality and termination under self-play: seeded AI-versus-AI battles end in victory or defeat within 100 turns and never accept an unaffordable card, a negative resource, an out-of-turn action or an action after battle end.

ENG-FR-01: Start each turn with exactly 3 energy, resetting rather than accumulating unspent energy; draw to a hand of 5, discard the entire hand at end of turn, reshuffle the discard pile when the draw pile empties, and burn cards drawn beyond 5. Card-granted energy may exceed 3 for the current turn.

ENG-FR-06: Plan enemy turns deterministically: prefer a lethal sequence, then a Ward at 12 or less enemy health, then a field-enabling Shift, then field-matching and highest damage-per-energy attacks; break ties by card ID, never plan an unaffordable card, and let the boss prefer the element that counters the player's starter element.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 200 seeded self-play battles finish with a winner or loser and no exception
No state has negative energy, hand size above 5, defense above 8 or health above maximum

Keep the suite under 10 seconds on the CI runner
